summary: 4-week to 6-month project training at DRDO laboratories; each lab sets its own intake, and some advertise paid internships.
eligibility: Engineering and science students routed through their college or institute to the specific lab; requirements differ by lab.
title: DRDO Student Internship / Project Training (lab-wise)

prize.description: Varies by lab; some labs advertise stipends.

notes: No DRDO-wide deadline. Earlier 2026 lab advertisements should not be treated as open; contact the target lab with a college letter.
